summary.text: Steve Mentzer is a Republican state representative from Lancaster County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 97 since December 2012 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He is the Republican chairman of the House Aging and Older Adult Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steven C. Mentzer is a lifelong resident of Lancaster County who graduated from Manheim Township High School and attended Elizabethtown College as a business administration major, according to his official biography.

He worked as a financial consultant at Smith Barney and as an account executive at Merrill Lynch before founding Central American Relief Efforts, a non-profit he headed as president that mobilizes volunteers and humanitarian aid for Central America.
He has been involved in humanitarian efforts since 2006 and is an elder at First Presbyterian Church.
Mentzer served as treasurer of Manheim Township before his election to the state House in November 2012.
For the 2025-26 session he is Republican chairman of the Aging and Older Adult Services Committee and a member of the Insurance and Professional Licensure committees.
He and his wife, Sally, live in Manheim Township and have two children.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Jess Branas as his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
